title: The Modern Cinema
teaser: The late show was over and the auditorium had emptied, but the projection booth still had its projector running and its door wide open. Rudolf Baum lies between the film reels. At the box office there are two tickets for different rows, bought within the same hour.
locations: The reel store in the cellar

habits.label: Cracks sunflower seeds
habits.habit: Cracks sunflower seeds from a paper twist
clues: There's a little heap of sunflower husks under the chair in the projection booth, and Baum never ate seeds. The culprit cracks sunflower seeds.
Fresh husks, not yet trodden in, are scattered on the iron stairs up to the booth. The culprit cracks sunflower seeds.

habits.label: Drinks lemonade
habits.habit: Drinks fizzy lemonade straight from the bottle
clues: An empty lemonade bottle lies on the booth floor, though the buffet closed long before the show ended. The culprit drinks lemonade.
The buffet attendant is one lemonade bottle short, and its cap turned up in the reel store. The culprit drinks lemonade.

habits.label: Hoarse voice
clues: The cashier heard someone call Baum's name in a hoarse voice by the staff exit. The culprit has a hoarse voice.
The last moviegoer remembers a hoarse "Lock up, Rudolf" from the dark foyer. The culprit has a strained, hoarse voice.

habits.label: Heel plates
clues: The steps of the iron stairs to the booth have fresh scratches from heel plates. The culprit has metal plates on their heels.
In the empty foyer the watchman heard a ringing clack on the tiles, like heel plates. The culprit has plates on their heels.

habits.label: Film-star postcards
clues: Postcards of Ladynina and Kryuchkov have disappeared from the display case in the foyer; the glass was carefully taken out and put back. The culprit collects postcards of film stars.
A postcard of Lyubov Orlova lies by the body, and on the back in pencil: "No. 112, for the collection". The culprit collects postcards of film stars.

habits.label: Lapel badge
habits.habit: An enamel badge on the lapel
clues: The clasp of an enamel badge with a broken pin was found between the reels. The culprit wears a badge on their lapel.
The velvet curtain at the booth entrance has a fresh pin hole, with a crumb of red enamel in the pile. The culprit wears an enamel badge.

habits.label: Scar over the brow
clues: By the light of the projector the usher made out a face with a scar over the brow at the booth door. The culprit has a scar over their brow.
Baum's notebook has an entry from a week ago: "The man with the scar over his brow is at the late show again." The culprit has a scar over their brow.

habits.label: Burn on the wrist
habits.habit: A pink burn mark on the wrist
clues: The bin by the staff exit holds a fresh bandage with burn ointment on it. The culprit has a burn on their wrist.
In the dark auditorium the ticket inspector noticed a hand with a pink burn mark on the wrist. The culprit has a burn mark on their wrist.

habits.label: Camera
clues: There's a cardboard box from photographic film, not cinema film, on the booth floor. The culprit carries a camera.
After the show, when the lights were already off, the dry click of a shutter came from the foyer. The culprit never goes anywhere without a camera.

habits.label: Checked scarf
clues: A red checked woollen thread is caught on a nail by the staff exit. The culprit wears a checked scarf.
The buffet attendant saw the end of a long checked scarf flash up the stairs to the booth. The culprit wears a long checked scarf.

habits.label: Smells of mothballs
clues: The stuffy booth smells of mothballs, while Baum's jacket smells only of film. The culprit's clothes smell of mothballs.
In the reel store a white mothball that fell out of someone's pocket lies on a film can. The culprit's clothes smell of mothballs.

habits.label: Reads lips
clues: Baum arranged the meeting through the box-office glass, where you can't hear a word, and still someone found out about it. The culprit reads lips.
A programme has words from a silent scene of the film written on it, words that are neither in the titles nor on the soundtrack. The culprit can read lips.

habits.label: Pocket watch on a chain
habits.habit: A pocket watch on a chain
clues: A link torn off a watch chain was found between the reels. The culprit carries a pocket watch on a chain.
In the dark aisle the usher heard the click of a pocket watch lid at exactly midnight. The culprit carries a watch on a chain.

habits.label: Quotes films
clues: A line from the film Circus has been copied onto the back of a ticket in someone else's hand. The culprit talks in lines from films.
The watchman heard a voice in the booth saying the lines from the screen word for word, a moment before the actors. The culprit knows films by heart.

habits.label: Paint under the nails
clues: The white handle of the booth door has a blue gouache fingerprint on it. The culprit has gouache under their nails.
There are crumbs of dried yellow gouache on the bell button by the staff exit. The culprit has gouache under their nails.

habits.label: Smells of garlic
clues: The cramped booth reeks of garlic, and Baum never touched the stuff. The culprit smells of garlic.
The cashier remembers that whoever bought the second ticket stank of garlic. The culprit smells of garlic.

tech: The sound in the auditorium was cut by swapping a wire on the amplifier, so nobody heard a scream. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The emergency light in the foyer was switched off at the board, and the switch was then put back. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
tools: The bolt on the booth door was taken off with a screwdriver and put back, the screws tightened. The culprit is handy with tools.
The rewinding table was taken apart and reassembled, every nut in place. The culprit is handy with tools.
cash: The late show's takings are sorted into bundles, but two hundred roubles are missing. The culprit had access to money.
Two tickets for different rows were punched within the same hour, but there's no money for them in the drawer. The culprit had access to money.
safe: The fireproof cabinet in the manager's office was opened without a single scratch. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The distribution ledger is missing from the safe, and the door was locked again on the combination. The culprit knows the safe combination.
passages: A narrow hatch, unknown to the audience, leads from the booth down to the reel store, and it's open. The culprit knows the service passages.
The staff exit is locked from the inside, yet dusty footprints lead into the passage behind the screen. The culprit knows the service passages.
sched: Someone came to Baum in the ten minutes when a reel runs by itself and the projectionist is free. The culprit knows the schedule.
The watchman walks round the auditorium at midnight, and the booth door was opened at five to. The culprit knows the schedule.
keys: The projection booth door was opened with a key, and the lock is intact. The culprit had keys.
The reel store is locked at night, yet in the morning the padlock was hanging open without a scratch. The culprit had keys.
candy: There's a sticky toffee wrapper on the booth floor. The culprit carries sweets.
A half-empty tin of fruit drops sits on the armrest of a seat in the back row. The culprit carries sweets.
quiet: The steps to the booth creak under any footstep, yet the watchman below heard nothing. The culprit moves silently.
Baum was caught off guard; he didn't even turn away from the projector. The culprit moves silently.
lefty: Baum was struck on the right temple, which is where a left-handed attacker's blow lands. The culprit is left-handed.
A chalk label on a film can is smudged from right to left, the way a left-hander writes. The culprit is left-handed.
french: A note has been slipped into the end of a reel: "Fin de séance". The culprit knows French.
A mistranslated title on the poster for a French film in the foyer has been corrected by hand. The culprit knows French.
glasses: A round lens from a pair of glasses lies under the rewinding table. The culprit wears glasses.
The booth window has a greasy mark where a glasses frame was pressed against the glass. The culprit wears glasses.
driver: There's a fresh tyre track from the mobile cinema van by the staff exit, though the van should be in the garage. The culprit can drive.
The key to the distribution lorry isn't on its own nail, and there's less petrol in the tank. The culprit can drive.
whistle: In the empty foyer the usher heard someone whistling the march from Jolly Fellows. The culprit whistles.
A moviegoer in the back row complained about soft whistling in the dark during the show. The culprit likes to whistle.
smoker: In the booth, where smoking is forbidden because of the film, there's a fresh Belomor cigarette end on the floor. The culprit smokes.
There's ash on the windowsill by the staff exit, though the bin was emptied before the show. The culprit smokes.
strong: The heavy projector has been moved, and it takes two people to lift it. The culprit is physically strong.
The staff exit door, which has been stuck since autumn, was yanked open in one go. The culprit is physically strong.
